verdict.rationale: Postman's docs clearly describe shared/synced workspaces where teams share, version, and discuss collections, with granular roles/permissions and live collaboration sessions (postman-docs-18, -21, -14, -13/20). However, community evidence raises real caveats: sharing is gated behind paid 'cloud' seats/lock-in (postman-comm-17), and there are reports of data loss or forced account creation disrupting synced workspaces (postman-comm-4, postman-comm-15), tempering the otherwise strong native support.
